# HS Strategic CFO Advisory

HS Strategic CFO Advisory provides fractional CFO and strategic finance advisory for Vancouver and BC owner-led businesses, with specialist acquisition, development and commercial real estate finance capability. The site is organized around the decisions owners are trying to make, supported by professional service pages.

Primary services:
- Fractional and part-time CFO Vancouver: https://hsstrategiccfo.com/business-growth-cfo
- Cash flow forecasting services Vancouver: https://hsstrategiccfo.com/business/cash-flow-forecasting-vancouver

## Customer decision hubs

## Supporting expertise
- Cash-flow forecasting and management reporting
- Lender-ready financial models and financing readiness
- Business borrowing capacity and debt-service analysis
- Acquisition financial due diligence and normalized EBITDA
- Business value and exit readiness
- Development pro formas, project cash flow, funding packages and lender draws
- Commercial real estate NOI, financing and investment analysis

Author and advisor:
- Calvin Zhou: https://hsstrategiccfo.com/about

Important scope note:
HS provides strategic financial analysis and decision support. Specific lending decisions remain with capital providers. Tax, legal, assurance, appraisal and regulated advice should be confirmed with the appropriate qualified professionals.
